readings: Doubles carry rounding into the residual. Every passing cycle's constant term is about 1e-16, not 0, because a ratio of published k0 is irrational. A load fraction that is not dyadic leaves the voltage coefficient off by about 5e-17. So an algebraic Wegscheider check needs §19's rounding band as well. The registered loads are dyadic, so every passing law's structural coefficients are exactly zero.

A diagram's own backward flux Π⁻Σ_κ/Σ differs from the contract's J⁺ e^{ΔG/RT} by e^{−r}. The residual r is about 1e-16 for the passing laws (power.A1_sign_and_zero.*.max_abs_ln_diagram_over_contract_backward). Booked with its own backward flux, an admitted diagram law shows J ΔG > 0 within |ΔG/RT| < |r| of equilibrium, at about 1e-37 here. The contract's J⁻ keeps the sign exact.

A form below its base (pi2_PO4) can make a ligand's total equivalents legitimately negative (S4's high-pH state, T_H = −1.86 fmol). The admissible floor is Σ_B T_B min_f n_{L,f}, not zero. Then @3's per-row ideal term RT n (ln(n/V) − 1) on the H row is undefined, and so is 'G* less the stored rows' own terms'. The booked term's ruling (§19 item 3) and any positivity guard on that row must account for it. P1b's floor is −0.5 fmol.
The guard's teeth show only on net-flow laws, since factored and admitted diagram laws cannot trip it. So its plants are published as net-flow test laws.
notes: Every constant, range and diagram is synthetic (D152 §2.4).
Hill 1989 and King and Altman 1956 are cited as CORE_SEAMS_DESIGN cites them, unread. The decomposition is self-verified by two routes and the edge-cycle consistency.
The booked closure term is registered by a dated amendment once ruled (§19 item 3).
The two composed worlds come later, with composition's references (§19).

Every deviation is in floors at its state. For seam A the floor is honest float64 rounding: on J (and rows, heat, work) (J⁺ + J⁻) × (ΔG/RT's terms + 8) eps, absolute, since near equilibrium no relative floor exists; on one-way fluxes and slopes (terms + 8) eps relative. For seam C it is the solution error that |g|/T ≤ 1e-13 admits. 'weak_at' lists the states below ten floors; a plant has power where its largest margin clears ten tolerances and the tolerance clears ten floors.
